_note: MEDICAL-REVIEW: every value in this file. Set reviewed to true only after a specialist signs it off.
source: WHO laboratory manual, 6th edition (2021), lower reference limits (5th centile)

volume.label: Volume
volume.line: How much fluid there is. Low volume can come from a short gap since the last ejaculation or a collection problem.

concentration.label: Concentration
concentration.line: How many sperm are in each millilitre.

total.label: Total count
total.line: All the sperm in the sample.

total_motility.label: Total motility
total_motility.line: How many sperm are moving at all.

progressive.label: Progressive motility
progressive.line: How many sperm are moving forward, which is the movement that matters for reaching the egg.

morphology.label: Normal forms
morphology.line: How many sperm have the usual shape. Most sperm in every man look unusual, so low numbers here are common.

repeat_line: One result is not a conclusion. Repeat the test after 2 to 3 months before acting.
